title: Metrics filenames should include a monotonic run number for efficient latest-finding
description: Finding the latest metrics file currently requires reading all filenames in the metrics directory and sorting by timestamp embedded in the UUID or run file. As the number of runs grows, this becomes an increasingly expensive directory scan. A monotonic run-number prefix would allow the latest metrics file to be located with a single sorted directory read.
proposed_resolution: Add a run_number field to the run state that increments monotonically per project (stored as a counter in .moeb/config.toml or a dedicated .moeb/run-counter file). Prefix metrics filenames with the zero-padded run number: {run_number}_{run_id}.metrics.json (e.g. 0042_abc123.metrics.json). Update all metrics-reading code paths to use lexicographic sort on the prefix rather than parsing UUIDs or timestamps. Migrate existing metrics files to the new naming convention as part of the spec.
